product_metadata.title: AVODAH 20 oz Tea Cup with Infuser and Lid. Tea Infuser Mug with Tea Infuser, Tea Strainer, Two Lids & Straw. Dishwasher Safe Coffee Travel Mug with Tea Accessories for Cold Brew Coffee or Tea (Blue)
features: UNIQUE TRAVEL MUG BUNDLE (Patent Pending) – A travel mug set with a removable snug fit infuser, lids and straw. The 2-in-1 infuser set can be used with the mug as tea accessory for brewing loose tea leaves, cold brew coffee, fruits or herbal infusion and as tea gifts

MULTI USE TRAVEL COFFEE MUG – Brew a single serve iced coffee and be ready to go by using the mug set as a cold brew maker. The mugs can be used as a tea strainer for brewing a large batch of loose leaf tea or green tea with the strainer lid only

SUPERIOR QUALITY – The travel mugs are double walled, vacuum insulated and made with food grade 304 stainless steel in both inner and outer walls. The outer wall is covered with high-quality powder coating for a smooth long lasting sweat free finish

TEMPERATURE RETENTION – Keep hot drinks hot & cold drinks cold with two airtight lids. One has a pop-up lid cover with straw hole for cold drinks. The other, made with shatter resistant Tritan comes with sliding lid & suited for use with the infuser

The infuser, strainer and travel mug with straw are made from 18/8 food grade 304 stainless steel that is BPA free and will not rust or dent. Enjoy the real taste of your infusions without any unwanted flavors. All parts are dishwasher safe making cleaning easierill not rust or dent.
